node.title: Re: could not open configuration file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I think the error message is pretty self-explanatory. Some quick Googling shows that the [http://homer.ucsd.edu/homer/introduction/install.html|"HOMER Installation Guide"] describes that one should download [http://homer.ucsd.edu/homer/configureHomer.pl|configureHomer.pl], save it in the directory where you would like the software to be installed (such as /home/username/homer), and then run perl /home/username/homer/configureHomer.pl -install. It looks like that script writes the config.txt file.
